text.arabic_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ

words.gloss_range: opening connective that resumes the prior watchpost claim and launches the prosperity case as an argued instance
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens as a hinge rather than a neutral fresh start. It keeps the human prosperity scene inside the prior watchpost claim, fuses quickly into the topical opening, and begins a connective chain that moves from discourse launch to benefaction to speech.

topics.headline: connector turns watchpost claim into case analysis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prosperity scene is an observed case following the prior watchpost claim, not detached anthropology.
topics.reason: The prefixed conjunction resumes discourse before the topical particle and keeps 89:15 tied to the preceding watchful-lordship claim.

topics.headline: compact prefixed opening and first connective in the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition as immediate and can track the ayah through its repeated connective turns.
topics.reason: The surface is a prefixed particle split from the following topical unit, and the ayah repeats connective turns at launch, benefaction, and response.

words.gloss_range: contrastive topic particle that suspends completion until the later response and sets up the first branch of a paired human test
words.prose: {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}) holds the human as a displayed case whose completion waits for the later response. It is both topical and conditional, preparing the paired contrast with 89:16 and letting the human stand under examination before his words arrive.

topics.headline: topical case waits for its response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the syntax delays completion until the speech response, making the human statement the outcome of the displayed case.
topics.reason: The particle is a conditional-topic marker and the later response clause completes its frame.

topics.headline: first prosperity branch under observation (89:16)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prosperity and deprivation as parallel observed tests rather than unrelated reports.
topics.reason: The contrastive frame opens the first branch completed in 89:16, while the prior watchpost context makes the coming speech already observed.

words.gloss_range: definite singular human type, locally the tested recipient who becomes the speaker and represents a recurring human reflex
words.root_gloss_range: human, familiarity, social recognition, and perception-associated range; local noun names the human type, while disputed forgetfulness pressure is only a cautious background contrast
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ}} ({{tr:al-insān}}) is put forward before the occasion of testing, so the ayah diagnoses a type before narrating what exposes him. Its definite singular form lets one voice represent a broader human reflex, while the pronoun chain keeps that same human moving from tested object to recipient and then speaker. The root-pressure around familiarity and perception sharpens the misreading: the human is at home with comfort yet fails to read it as trial. The same type overreads self-sufficiency in 96:6-7 and remembers too late in 89:23.

topics.headline: definite singular human as recurring type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recognizable human type, not a private anecdotal character.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, nominative, and topical after the conditional-topic particle; contextual profiles identify generic humans as the dominant referent.

topics.headline: same human moves from object to speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one referent through testing, receiving, being eased, and speaking.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the object suffixes and the speech subject back to the topical human.

topics.headline: familiarity and perception pressure without verbalizing the noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the human as a creature comfortable with favor and recognition, while local grammar keeps the surface as a class noun.
topics.reason: The root pressure coheres with the prosperity scene, but the local form names a human type rather than asserting a perception or forgetting event.

topics.headline: self-reading parallels and later reversal (96:6-7; 89:23)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this confident prosperity reading with human overreach in 96:6-7 and late recognition in 89:23.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references where the same human type overreads independence or later remembers too late.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional when/whenever frame that makes the prosperity episode a repeatable testing scenario
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) turns the following perfect verb into a scenario: whenever this testing comes, the human response can be predicted. Inside the larger topical frame, it narrows the displayed human case to benefit-as-test, and the condition runs through honoring and easing before speech. It also prepares the mirrored testing frame in 89:16.

topics.headline: temporal condition makes the scene repeatable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a perfect testing event is placed inside a recurring when/whenever scenario.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as the temporal conditional adverb governing the test clause.

topics.headline: condition includes benefit before speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that honoring and easing are included as the material that produces the response.
topics.reason: Attachment clauses show the conditional frame leading through the benefactive clauses into the response.

topics.headline: condition phrase anticipates opposite test (89:16)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 89:15 and 89:16 as matched trial frames whose material conditions reverse.
topics.reason: The row identifies the testing phrase as a reprise in the next ayah.

words.gloss_range: reinforcing particle after the temporal condition, broadening the whenever-force while not serving as the verb object
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) thickens the conditional frame rather than supplying the object of testing. The object slot is already filled by the attached human suffix on the testing verb, so this particle broadens the whenever-force and gives the condition an extra beat before the Lord’s testing action is named. It also belongs to the repeated testing formula mirrored in 89:16.

topics.headline: reinforcing particle, not object of the test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle strengthens recurrence rather than naming what is tested.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the attached human suffix as the direct object of the testing verb.

topics.headline: small delay in repeated test formula (89:16)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the condition tighten before the test verb and hears the same formula mirrored in 89:16.
topics.reason: The particle stands between the temporal condition and the test verb and recurs in the paired formula.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII completed testing of the human, locally a deliberate divine examination whose material can include benefit
words.root_gloss_range: testing, proving, trying, exposing quality through experience or use; local Form VIII selects deliberate examination of the human, not hardship-only trial
words.prose: {{ar:ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ}} ({{tr:ibtalāhu}}) gives the prosperity scene its controlling frame before honor or ease appears. The human is the object of the completed test, while the following agent names the Lord as tester, so the benefits are not impersonal fortune. The root’s proving-and-exposure pressure makes comfort itself a testing environment, not a sign that examination has ended; 21:35 makes that range explicit by placing good and evil within trial. The exact test frame returns in 89:16, making benefit and constriction two forms of examination.

topics.headline: perfect test verb controls the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that testing is named before the benefits, so later speech is framed as a response to examination.
topics.reason: The verb is a Form VIII perfect inside the condition and governs the benefactive sequence.

topics.headline: human object and Lord agent remain distinct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the human first as the acted-upon object of testing before he becomes interpreter of the test.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as direct object and the following Lord noun as overt subject.

topics.headline: comfort can be the material of trial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that honor and ease are the very material of the test, not proof that testing has ended.
topics.reason: The root field supports proving through exposure, and 21:35 keeps good and evil within a trial frame.

topics.headline: same testing frame returns under constriction (89:16)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads prosperity and constriction as paired examinations because the test wording is repeated in 89:16.
topics.reason: The rows identify the adjacent-ayah reprise and the attachment data keeps both benefactive verbs under the test frame.

words.gloss_range: the human’s Lord as overt nominative agent and possessed governing relation in the testing scene
words.root_gloss_range: lord, master, owner, sustainer, nurturer, and governor; locally the possessed Lord who tests and then acts benefactively toward the human

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first-person possessed Lord noun later inside the human quote

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّهُۥ}} ({{tr:rabbuhu}}) names the tester as the human’s own Lord, not a remote force or impersonal fortune. Its possessed form binds lordship to the human under examination, while its nominative role supplies the agent for the test and following benefactions. The root range of ownership, nurture, and governance makes the testing relation caring and governing at once. Later the same relation enters the human’s mouth as {{ar:رَبِّىٓ}} ({{tr:rabbī}}), shifting narrated agency into self-interpreting speech. The same Lord relation also frames the opposite test in 89:16 and the return address in 89:28, so this local agent belongs to the surah’s wider lordship thread.

topics.headline: possessed Lord is the testing agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one testing the human is named as his own Lord and agent.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the noun as the subject of the testing verb and the possessed relation as grammatically forced.

topics.headline: lordship includes nurture and governance through testing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the test as an act inside sustaining governance, not as a contradiction of care.
topics.reason: The root field supports master-owner, sustainer, and cultivating governance, and the local agent role applies that range to examination.

topics.headline: narrated Lord becomes quoted Lord later in the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches a true lordship relation move from narration into the human’s own claim.
topics.reason: The same root appears first in narrated agency and later in the quote as {{ar:رَبِّىٓ}} ({{tr:rabbī}}), shifting from third person to first person.

topics.headline: same Lord relation in mirror and return scenes (89:16; 89:28)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this testing Lord within the surah’s wider lordship thread, including 89:16 and 89:28.
topics.reason: The rows point to dense same-surah lordship recurrence and the transition from addressed certainty into the human case.

words.gloss_range: sequential/result connective that links the test frame to the first benefactive act
words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) moves from testing into honoring, so benefit appears as the next stage inside the trial rather than as an exit from it. Its sequence can also be heard as explanatory consequence: the test takes the form of bestowed honor. As the middle connective, it balances the opening hinge and the later speech-response hinge, preparing the mirrored constriction hinge in 89:16.

topics.headline: test moves into honoring as trial material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that honoring follows as part of the test sequence, not as a separate reward scene.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the honoring verb to the testing verb in the trial sequence.

topics.headline: middle connective between discourse launch and speech response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the ayah’s procedural movement: opening case, benefactive action, then spoken response, with 89:16 reversing the material condition.
topics.reason: The local connective chain and the adjacent mirror ayah support this procedural reading.

words.gloss_range: Form IV bestowed honoring of the same human object, positive in value but framed as trial content
words.root_gloss_range: honor, generosity, nobility, preciousness, and gracious bestowal; locally conferred honor to the human inside the test, not a final status verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the quoted first-person Form IV honor predicate that echoes the narrated honor verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَكْرَمَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akramahu}}) is the first benefactive act inside the test. The Form IV and attached object make bestowed honor concrete: the same human who was tested is now honored. The root’s range of nobility, preciousness, and generosity makes the act stronger than bare material gain, but the prior test frame keeps it from becoming a final verdict. This received honor sits beside broader human honoring in 17:70 and is challenged by the later failure to honor the orphan in 89:17. The same form returns in the quote as {{ar:أَكْرَمَنِ}} ({{tr:akramani}}), shifting the endpoint from narrated “him” to quoted “me.”

topics.headline: Form IV honor acts on the same human object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees honor as a completed divine act received by the same human under test.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the pro-drop subject to the Lord and the object suffix to the topical human.

topics.headline: nobility and generosity remain positive but tested
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act is genuinely positive and honor-laden, yet its positivity is what becomes testing material.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports conferred honor and generosity, while the testing verb governs the benefactive sequence.

topics.headline: honor language tested by human response (17:70; 89:17)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this received honor with human honoring in 17:70 and the later failure to honor the orphan in 89:17.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references where honor language moves between bestowed dignity and ethical obligation.

topics.headline: narrated honor echoes in the final claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the human echo the narrator’s honor verb, sharpening the irony of true wording put into a wrong frame.
topics.reason: The same Form IV root appears in narration and in the final quoted predicate {{ar:أَكْرَمَنِ}} ({{tr:akramani}}), with the object endpoint shifting.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that joins honoring and easing into one composite benefaction pair
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) widens the test material by pairing honor with comfort. It coordinates the second benefactive verb with the first, without requiring a strict new sequence, so status and ease are heard as a composite prosperity package before the speech response.

topics.headline: coordination joins the two benefactive verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second act is coordinated with the first, so the benefits accumulate as one paired trial material.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the easing verb as coordinated with the honoring verb.

topics.headline: honor and comfort stand together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the test is not only status nor only comfort; the verse pairs both forms of prosperity.
topics.reason: The coordinated verbs place conferred honor and caused ease in a single benefactive sequence.

words.gloss_range: Form II caused ease or pleasant enjoyment given to the same human object as the second benefactive act
words.root_gloss_range: favor, pleasant ease, comfort, enjoyment, and blessing; locally caused comfortable enjoyment under examination, not unaccountable bliss
words.prose: {{ar:نَعَّمَهُۥ}} ({{tr:naʿʿamahu}}) completes the benefaction pair by adding caused ease to conferred honor. The same human object receives the action, and the Form II intensity makes the comfort actively produced, not merely present; the intensified sound also lets this rare form land as the audible second half of the honor-and-ease pair. The root field of favor, pleasant living, and enjoyment remains positive, but the test frame turns ease into accountable trial material; 102:8 later makes enjoyment itself an object of questioning.

topics.headline: Form II gives caused comfort to the same human
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that comfort is actively bestowed on the same human, completing the paired divine benefaction.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence keeps the Lord as subject through coordination and identifies the object suffix as the same human recipient.

topics.headline: pleasant enjoyment remains positive but tested
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels ease and pleasant living as real blessing while seeing them as the material through which the human is examined.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports favor and pleasant enjoyment, while the local test frame governs the benefactive sequence.

topics.headline: enjoyment turns toward questioning (102:8)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects enjoyed ease here with later accountability for enjoyment in 102:8.
topics.reason: The rows identify the concrete echo where enjoyment becomes subject to questioning.

topics.headline: paired prosperity is audible and form-specific
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the intensified easing verb as the audible second half of a rare, tight honor-and-ease construction.
topics.reason: The contextual data marks this exact Form II occurrence as low frequency, and local coordination pairs it with the honor verb.

words.gloss_range: response connective that closes the condition and pivots from divine acts to human speech
words.prose: The final {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the response: after the topical frame, the conditional test, and the two benefactions, the outcome is speech. It pivots from divine action to human interpretation and completes the ayah’s connective chain. The same speech-response architecture is mirrored in 89:16, where the material condition reverses but the response frame remains.

topics.headline: response connective closes the nested condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech is the grammatical response to the whole test sequence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the speech clause as the conditional response after the topical and temporal frames.

topics.headline: pivot from benefaction to interpretation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the verse turn from what the Lord does to what the human says those acts mean.
topics.reason: The connective is prefixed to the speech verb and follows the completed benefactive sequence.

topics.headline: speech-response frame is mirrored in the paired ayah (89:16)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader expects the next ayah to preserve the speech frame while reversing the material condition.
topics.reason: The adjacent ayah repeats the test-and-response architecture under constriction.

words.gloss_range: imperfect active speech verb introducing the human’s quoted interpretation as a recurring response
words.root_gloss_range: saying, uttering, formulating a verbal position or claim; locally the human’s articulated interpretation of prosperity
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُ}} ({{tr:yaqūlu}}) makes the test disclose itself through speech. After perfect divine acts, the imperfect keeps the response open and recurring: whenever this prosperity test arrives, the human says this. The verb introduces a direct quote, so the flaw is an articulated interpretation rather than a hidden mood, and the ayah closes inside that human output before explicit correction arrives. The speech pattern recurs with deprivation in 89:16 and turns to regret in 89:24; 39:49 gives another scene where benefit produces a self-explaining claim.

topics.headline: imperfect speech follows completed divine acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that completed acts lead into a repeatable speech response, not a one-time report.
topics.reason: The verb is an active imperfect with a quoted complement, and the pro-drop subject resolves to the topical human.

topics.headline: saying becomes a formulated self-assessment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the error as a claim-shaped interpretation of prosperity, not as mere feeling.
topics.reason: The root field and local quoted complement support speech as formulated stance or claim.

topics.headline: the ayah ends inside the human’s quoted output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refutation is prepared structurally by letting the human’s own sentence close the case.
topics.reason: The quotation is the local complement of the speech verb and the structural endpoint of the prosperity test.

topics.headline: benefit, deprivation, and regret speech parallels (39:49; 89:16; 89:24)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this speech with benefit-based self-explanation in 39:49, the opposite test in 89:16, and later regret in 89:24.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references where similar speech frames expose human self-interpretation.

words.gloss_range: first-person possessed Lord inside quoted speech, a true dependency relation used by the speaker for self-status interpretation
words.root_gloss_range: lord, master, owner, sustainer, nurturer, and governor; locally the speaker’s possessed Lord in a quoted claim, with broad lordship compressed into a status inference

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the third-person possessed Lord noun in the narrated testing frame

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّىٓ}} ({{tr:rabbī}}) is true speech before it is flawed interpretation: the human really names his Lord as the giver. But the first-person possessive pulls the governing relation into the speaker’s own mouth, and the quote immediately turns that relation into evidence for personal honor. The shift from narrated {{ar:رَبُّهُۥ}} ({{tr:rabbuhu}}) to spoken {{ar:رَبِّىٓ}} ({{tr:rabbī}}) exposes self-appropriation of lordship. Qiraat that open the possessive vowel can make the move into “honored me” flow more tightly without changing the grammar.

topics.headline: possessed Lord fronts the quoted claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speaker begins with a real dependency relation before turning to his received honor.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the first-person suffix as possessive and links the following predicate to this fronted Lord noun.

topics.headline: broad lordship reduced to honor verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the theological flaw: true lordship is narrowed into proof of the speaker’s elevated status.
topics.reason: The root range supports sustaining and governing lordship, while the quoted clause compresses that relation into an honor conclusion.

topics.headline: opened possessive vowel tightens the claim-chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear how a recitational opening of the possessive ending smooths the movement from “my Lord” into “honored me.”
topics.reason: The variant affects the phonological flow from the possessed Lord noun into the predicate without changing local syntax.

topics.headline: narrated Lord becomes private claim and repeats in opposite test (89:16)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks lordship from narrated testing agency into the human’s private formula, then into the opposite test response in 89:16.
topics.reason: The rows identify the same-root shift within 89:15 and the repeated first-person Lord formula in 89:16.

words.gloss_range: first-person Form IV “honored me” predicate, semantically plausible as received honor but false as a detached status verdict
words.root_gloss_range: honor, generous treatment, nobility, preciousness, and bestowed favor; locally a true received act converted by the speaker into self-confirming verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the testing verb that frames the quoted honor claim
the narrated Form IV honor verb echoed by the final quote

words.prose: {{ar:أَكْرَمَنِ}} ({{tr:akramani}}) closes the ayah on the human’s self-referred endpoint. Grammatically, the Lord remains the subject and the first-person suffix receives the act; semantically, the claim can name real honoring. The failure is the inference: the speaker isolates the honor from {{ar:ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ}} ({{tr:ibtalāhu}}) and treats a tested gift as a finished status verdict. The form mirrors the narrator’s {{ar:أَكْرَمَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akramahu}}) while shifting “him” to “me,” and recitational continuation can make that final “me” linger without changing the lexical claim. The later charge of not honoring the orphan in 89:17 and the self-certifying favor logic of 41:50 test whether received honor becomes ethical action or only a pious status claim.

topics.headline: completed honor lands on “me”
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on the speaker as object of honor, making self-status the final sound of the verse.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence ties the pro-drop subject to the fronted Lord noun and the final suffix to the quoted speaker.

topics.headline: real honor becomes a false final verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the statement is dangerous: it is plausible as wording but wrong when detached from the testing frame.
topics.reason: The root range supports honor and generous treatment, but the governing trial frame prevents the claim from functioning as a final status verdict.

topics.headline: narrated honor returns as first-person claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same bestowed-honor form move from narrated benefaction to first-person status language.
topics.reason: The local ayah contains paired Form IV honor surfaces, first as {{ar:أَكْرَمَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akramahu}}) and then as {{ar:أَكْرَمَنِ}} ({{tr:akramani}}), with the object suffix shifting.

topics.headline: recitational variants make the closing “me” sensitive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear how continuation variants make the first-person endpoint linger at the verse close without changing the claim’s lexical value.
topics.reason: The qiraat notes concern the final first-person ending at closure, not a different local predicate.

topics.headline: self-certifying favor is challenged by later duty (41:50; 89:17; 89:16)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the pious-sounding self-confirmation here with the cruder “this is mine” logic in 41:50, the orphan-honor charge in 89:17, and the reversed self-status claim in 89:16.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete parallels where favor becomes self-certifying speech and where received honor is tested by ethical honoring.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The testing verb at word 5 governs the honoring and favoring sequence, and the speech at word 9 is the human response to that sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Benefaction is the test medium, while the human's proposition is part of what the test discloses. By repeating the honor event but dropping its test frame, the response converts a condition under examination into a settled verdict about the self.

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals condition makes the prosperity sequence diagnostic rather than merely distributive.
Real nobility and generosity remain present in both the narrated gift and its quoted repetition.
Pleasant well-being supplies the favorable condition through which the hidden judgment is elicited.
Speech as held belief makes the utterance an exposed interpretive doctrine, not a neutral report.

changed_reading.before: Prosperity is straightforward evidence that the recipient has already been judged honorable.
changed_reading.after: Prosperity is the test instrument, and the recipient's belief that it settles his rank is itself what the test brings into view.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus explicitly attributes honoring and easeful favor to the Lord inside the testing clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trial and actual good are not opposites. The good-benefaction branch of testing allows a genuine gift to remain a trial, so the interpretive fault can lie in overextending a true event into a final valuation rather than denying that any honor occurred.

activation_trace.role: A good trial and beautiful benefaction hold favorable treatment and examination together.
Being treated as dear or highly valued supplies a genuine relational honor without making it an irrevocable rank.
Softness and easeful living specify the concrete good that can simultaneously carry diagnostic pressure.
Speech that purports to state a thing's defining reality shows the human turning one event into an exhaustive definition.

changed_reading.before: Because the prosperity is a test, the narrated honor must be merely apparent or ironic.
changed_reading.after: The benefaction can be genuine while remaining non-final; the error is making a true received honor define the recipient's enduring worth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The response names the giver as 'my Lord' and attributes the honoring to that giver rather than to the human's own power.
baseline_models.mechanism: Focus-only syntax still permits grateful attribution. Repeated lordship can connect nurture to acknowledgment, while the first-person object can either receive relation humbly or close the gift around the self; the focus alone does not force those possibilities apart.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion make lordship a continuing formative relation rather than a momentary dispenser of status.
Overt utterance allows the line to function as explicit acknowledgment of the giver.
Praiseworthy generosity gives the acknowledgment a real object rather than requiring empty boasting.

changed_reading.before: The utterance is necessarily arrogant self-congratulation.
changed_reading.after: In isolation it can coexist as grateful attribution to a nurturing Lord, though it may still close the meaning of honor around the speaker.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same honor root names both the Lord's action and the human's account of what he received.
baseline_models.mechanism: A gift that anticipates recompense, placed under covenantal lordship, makes honor an advance in a relation rather than a completed possession. The human's speech can name receipt while leaving open whether he will answer the gift or treat the account as closed.

activation_trace.role: A gift offered for recompense supplies the latent expectation that received honor should generate an answering act.
The covenant branch gives lordship a binding relational frame in which benefaction can carry obligation.
Drawing a saying toward oneself marks the point where a relational gift may be appropriated into a self-enclosed account.

changed_reading.before: Honor is a one-way possession with no demanded sequel.
changed_reading.after: Honor can be heard as an advance within reciprocity: the words name receipt, but the receiver's answering performance remains unresolved.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence places emergence, darkness, pairedness, singularity, and movement in one ordered field. Prosperity therefore reads less like a permanent identity and more like one passing configuration whose diagnostic meaning requires restraint rather than instant inference.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies a condition-revealing test whose temporal shape the opening sequence can revise.
Dawn breaking out of night supplies a state transition rather than a fixed condition.
Night's darkness supplies the contrasting phase through which emergence becomes legible.
Joining a thing to its counterpart supplies a paired state within the sequence.
The unpaired single supplies a coexisting opposite that prevents one configuration from becoming the whole.
Night travel makes even the dark phase mobile and headed beyond itself.
Restraining intellect supplies the faculty needed not to absolutize a favorable phase.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves through dawn, counted nights, paired and unpaired states, and a night in transit before asking whether a restraining intellect finds an oath in it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating and moving states; I infer that the focus condition belongs to that temporal grammar and therefore cannot certify permanent rank. A live alternative is that the oath objects attest independently without mapping onto changes of fortune.

changed_reading.before: Present ease transparently reveals a stable divine valuation.
changed_reading.after: Present ease is one mobile phase in an alternating test, and the rush to make it permanent is precisely a failure of restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The historical sequence scales bestowed capacity into pillars, penetrated rock, fixed power, competitive increase, breached limits, and systemic corruption, all under watch. The focus human becomes a small-scale version of a polity that reads visible capacity as proof of elevation and thereby turns a test into entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Received nobility and generosity supply the individual capacity that the historical sequence scales into public power.
Height and elevation in pillars materialize a claim to exceptional standing.
Penetrating cuts turn capacity into durable command over resistant material.
Peg-like fixity supplies the political fantasy that achieved power cannot move or end.
Crossing the limit supplies the transition from capacity to transgression.
Competitive increase supplies the scaling drive by which possession seeks to prove superiority.
Departure from sound order names the social output of capacity detached from its test.
Watchful surveillance closes the mechanism by keeping apparently secure power inside evaluation.

structural_cues: The focus follows a chain of exemplary powers whose exceptional construction and territorial dominance do not escape the repeated Lord-reference or the final watchpost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies monumental capacity, increase, transgression, corruption, and surveillance; I infer a causal scale model in which private entitlement is the seed form of public domination. The live alternative is that the histories warn generally and are not a direct psychology of the focus speaker.

changed_reading.before: The focus diagnoses only a private mistake about personal comfort.
changed_reading.after: The private claim is also a compact political pattern: bestowed capacity becomes self-certified elevation, then exceeds limits while imagining itself fixed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent case repeats the testing and speaking frame under restricted provision, but reverses the human verdict from honor to humiliation. The two utterances function as a binary classifier that mistakes quantity of provision for quality of divine regard.

activation_trace.role: The focus establishes prosperity as one state-revealing test.
The repeated disclosure-test branch places constriction under exactly the same diagnostic operator.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the material opposite of the focus abundance.
Apportioned giving makes amount a distributional condition rather than a transparent status score.
Speech functioning as supposition marks the humiliation verdict as an inference rather than direct knowledge.
Humiliation by devaluation supplies the negative rank judgment projected onto material restriction.

structural_cues: The two cases repeat the conditional testing frame, the Lord-reference, and the resulting speech while reversing only the material condition and rank verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a controlled contrast between abundance and constriction; I infer that the paired human verdicts are the exposed error, not authoritative readings of regard. A narrower alternative is that only the constriction verdict is corrected, though the syntactic symmetry keeps both classifications under pressure.

changed_reading.before: The honor statement reliably decodes prosperity, while humiliation would reliably decode scarcity.
changed_reading.after: Both statements are reactive classifications produced inside one test; neither material pole by itself measures divine regard.

context_deltas.mechanism: The honor root moves from what the human receives to what the community fails to do for a person cut off from support. Favor is therefore not completed at reception: it becomes capacity that must be relayed as honor, encouragement, food, and stabilizing sustenance.

activation_trace.role: Received praiseworthy generosity supplies the resource and relation that can be passed onward.
The same generosity branch relocates honor from passive status to an action performed toward another.
Severance from a protector identifies the social break that received honor is meant to bridge.
Urging action makes the obligation contagious and communal rather than exhausted by private charity.
Feeding another turns favor into material transmission.
Sustenance that stabilizes a person's stay gives the relay a durable social aim.

structural_cues: The corrective immediately reuses the honor root transitively toward the orphan and follows it with a plural failure to mobilize feeding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical reuse and a sequence of unmet social acts; I infer that received honor is tested by whether it circulates to the unsupported. A live alternative is that these are separate vices, but the immediate reuse of the honor root makes circulation the tighter explanation.

changed_reading.before: To be honored is to occupy the receiving end of divine generosity.
changed_reading.after: Received honor remains incomplete until it is relayed as enacted dignity and sustenance toward those cut off from support.

context_deltas.mechanism: Transferred wealth is consumed as wealth, gathered without distinction, attached to the heart, and accumulated toward fullness. This supplies the blocked-flow mechanism behind the focus pronoun: the human turns bestowed ease into an enclosure around 'me' instead of allowing inherited and present provision to continue through a social field.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed well-being supplies the stock or capacity whose subsequent handling reveals its receiver.
Taking and consuming wealth supplies the conversion of a transferable good into private depletion.
Transfer from predecessor to heir shows that the wealth already belongs to a chain rather than originating with its current holder.
Gathering scattered parts supplies indiscriminate enclosure into one holder.
Love clinging to the heart supplies the affective lock that keeps accumulation in place.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth names the object around which the self builds its status.
Accumulation until fullness gives the enclosure its terminal image.

structural_cues: The singular human's first-person conclusion expands into plural social habits of total consumption and intense accumulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transfer, consumption, gathering, heart-attachment, and accumulation; I infer a blocked circulation whose first verbal symptom is the focus on 'me.' An alternative is simple greed without a flow model, but inheritance and feeding make movement between persons materially active.

changed_reading.before: The statement merely mistakes wealth for an abstract badge of rank.
changed_reading.after: The statement can inaugurate an economic enclosure: favor becomes 'mine,' transferred goods stop moving, and accumulation itself is treated as proof of honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated demolition levels the common ground, after which repeated rows replace private elevation with ordered exposure. The human's honor claim is recast as a temporary vertical distinction that cannot survive the material removal of height and the reassembly of all positions on one plane.

activation_trace.role: Nobility supplies the rank-like reading that the later spatial sequence can level.
Pounding and demolition to level ground supply the destruction of constructed elevation.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the shared plane onto which claims of height descend.
Alignment on a level line replaces solitary elevation with ordered and exposed position.

structural_cues: The doubled leveling expression is followed by doubled rows, producing a strong flatten-and-reorder sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal leveling and alignment; I infer a spatial reversal of status hierarchy. The live alternative is a purely cosmological scene with no social-rank entailment, so the status application remains analogical.

changed_reading.before: Honor is a durable elevation possessed by one recipient.
changed_reading.after: Honor understood as private height is provisional: constructed elevations are leveled and the self is repositioned within an exposed order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human reappears in a second speech scene after remembrance, now wishing that something had been advanced for life. This later utterance retroactively identifies the focus prosperity as forwardable capacity: the first statement celebrates what reached the self, while the second regrets what the self failed to send ahead.

activation_trace.role: The first speech draws the event toward the present self and supplies one end of the verbal reversal.
Recovery after forgetfulness supplies the belated interpretive correction.
The reappearance of the visible human role links the later recognition to the focus speaker type.
A second overt utterance creates an audible counterstatement to the focus conclusion.
Advancing something forward supplies the missing directional use of present favor.
Life as benefit and good names the destination for which received capacity should have been made productive.

structural_cues: The same human and speech lexemes frame an immediate prosperity verdict and a later retrospective wish, creating two temporally opposed readings by one generic role.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence, remembrance, and forward movement; I infer that favor received in the first scene was an opportunity to be advanced. A live alternative is that the two speakers are merely different generic humans, but the repeated role still creates a deliberate comparison.

changed_reading.before: The decisive sentence about prosperity is 'my Lord honored me.'
changed_reading.after: That sentence is an early, selfward reading later corrected by the wish to have converted present favor into forward-moving good.

context_deltas.mechanism: A contrasting self settles, returns to the Lord, enters mutual acceptance, joins a servant collective, and enters a sheltered garden. This supplies an alternative completion of lordly nurture: honor is not enclosed as a first-person possession but realized through return, reciprocal relation, and incorporation into a larger belonging.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion supply the focus relation whose endpoint the return sequence can disclose.
The self as the thing itself relocates evaluation from possessions to the formed person.
Settled tranquility supplies a non-reactive posture opposite the rapid status verdicts.
Return to what one came from supplies movement back into relation rather than possession of its gifts.
The same nurturing lordship becomes the destination and completion of the returning self.
Mutual satisfaction supplies a two-way relation unlike a unilateral claim to have received status.
Entry into an inside supplies actual incorporation rather than verbal self-designation.
Humble obedience supplies the collective relation into which the settled self enters.
The tree-covered garden supplies a sheltered common destination rather than a present possession used as rank.

structural_cues: The closing imperatives move from the self to the Lord, then into servants, then into the garden through a return-and-entry sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a settled self, return, mutual acceptance, and nested entry; I infer an alternative anthropology of honor centered on formed relation and belonging. A live alternative is that this addressee is simply a different human type, not a direct revision of the focus speaker.

changed_reading.before: The possessive phrase 'my Lord' confirms that the speaker already possesses the relation and its honor.
changed_reading.after: The Lord-relation reaches completion through a settled self's return, mutual acceptance, and entry into shared service and shelter, not through claiming the gift as rank.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the peripheral pupil-image and mirror branches rather than the ordinary human and seeing senses. It remains anchored in the focus human's first-person interpretation and in the later recurrence of the human under a command to see and a scene of remembrance. Render it only as an optical analogy for self-projection, not as a replacement lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus begins with the human and ends with that human reading prosperity back as a verdict about himself.

activation_trace.role: The small human image visible in the pupil supplies a reflected self nested inside the act of seeing.
View, spectacle, and mirror supply the optical surface on which self-projection can occur.
The repeated pupil-image branch carries the reflected human from immediate perception into belated recognition.
Remembering after forgetfulness supplies the breaking of the earlier reflected interpretation.

changed_reading.before: The human looks at prosperity and sees an objective divine verdict.
changed_reading.after: Prosperity may function like a pupil-mirror: the human sees his own desired image in the gift and mistakes that reflection for the giver's final judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the material wearing-out branch of the test root into a moral mechanism and reinforces it with another garment-wear branch. It remains anchored directly in the focus testing verb and explains disclosure as abrasion. Render it as a controlled material analogy, not as the direct contextual gloss of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names the favorable event with a root whose inventory holds both testing-disclosure and physical wear.

activation_trace.role: Wearing out and decay supply the material process by which repeated use exposes what a surface is made of.
Testing that discloses condition connects the material abrasion back to the focus's diagnostic action.
A garment losing its nap through wear reinforces the image of use stripping away a polished surface.

changed_reading.before: Prosperity is a pleasant object placed inside an otherwise abstract examination.
changed_reading.after: Prosperity is itself the friction of the examination: living in ease wears the presented self until its underlying interpretive fabric appears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because rain, soft wind, bursting generosity, and plant growth are cross-domain branches rather than the ordinary social senses. It remains anchored in the focus's honor and ease roots and is strengthened by context provision and garden roots. Render it as an ecological model of circulation and fruitfulness, not as a claim that the focus literally describes weather.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus couples honoring with a causative making-easy or making-blessed, allowing the gift to be modeled as a productive condition rather than a static badge.

activation_trace.role: Good growth and rain-bearing bounty make honor productive beyond the point where it lands.
A soft wind supplies the enabling medium through which favorable conditions move rather than remain owned.
Bursting, expansive generosity supplies an outward release opposed to enclosure around the recipient.
Rain descending as provision links apportioned gift to a circulating ecological source.
Interwoven, surging vegetation supplies the eventual fruitfulness of favor that has not been arrested.

changed_reading.before: Honor is a discrete asset delivered to and possessed by one human.
changed_reading.after: Honor can be carried as rain-like throughput meant to generate wider growth; the emphatic 'me' risks damming a flow into private status.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of the focus Lord-root to activate increase and rising, then places that echo against later leveling. The packet explicitly preserves that mapped inventory, and the reading remains anchored in the repeated Lord word and the focus rank claim. Render it only as a split-root resonance about elevation, never as the lexical definition of Lord.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated Lord word frames both the bestowed elevation and the human's conclusion that he has been elevated in worth.

activation_trace.role: The preserved non-dominant branch of increase and rising supplies a latent vertical echo inside the repeated Lord-reference.
Growth in number supplies the outward increase that can be mistaken for inward elevation.
Flattening and lowering reverse the latent rise and expose it as temporary topography.

changed_reading.before: The giver's increase of the human proves that the human is intrinsically higher.
changed_reading.after: Being made to rise is not being made inherently high; increase is a temporary contour inside lordly testing and can be flattened.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the recompense-seeking gift and covenant branches with later binding and mutual satisfaction, making an economic-legal model out of honor. It remains directly anchored in the repeated honor and Lord roots and gains a visible sequel in the later bond and reciprocal acceptance. Render it as a relational analogy, not as a commercial reduction of grace.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The Lord gives honor, the human records receipt in speech, and the focus leaves the recipient's answering action unstated.

activation_trace.role: A gift that seeks recompense supplies the image of honor as an advance awaiting response.
Covenant and pact place the advance within a binding relation rather than an isolated transfer.
The later confirmed bond externalizes the obligation that the focus recipient leaves unanswered.
Mutual satisfaction supplies a non-punitive completion in which both sides of the relation answer each other.

changed_reading.before: The statement closes the account by confirming that honor has been received.
changed_reading.after: The statement may be only a receipt for an advance: honor opens an obligation whose completion appears as either binding accountability or mutual satisfaction.

strongest_changes: The paired abundance and constriction scenes make material condition a test variable, while the human's rank verdict is the disclosed result.
The immediate reuse of honor toward the orphan and the feeding sequence relocate honor from received status to socially relayed action.
Inheritance consumption and wealth accumulation expose the first-person honor claim as a possible mechanism of enclosure, not merely a mistaken private opinion.
The later human speech revises present receipt into a missed opportunity to send good forward, while the closing return offers relational completion instead of possessed rank.
summary.what_was_special: Several readings remain live together: the benefaction can be genuine, the focus utterance can retain a residue of grateful attribution, and yet its final-status inference can fail. The packet also sustained contained optical, abrasive, ecological, covenantal, and split-root elevation models that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not settle whether the narrated honoring is unqualified honor, accommodated description, or genuine but provisional benefaction.
The later remembering human may continue the same generic role or contrast one human type with another; the lexical recurrence supports comparison without proving identity.

The pupil, wear, weather, recompense, covenant, and non-dominant rising branches are productive analogies, but their distance requires downstream prose to mark them as exploratory rather than lexical replacements.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Favor as disclosure-test, not status-verdict.** Lexical evidence: `ء ن س B001` visible human presence; `ب ل و B002` testing and disclosure of state; `ر ب ب B002` nurture and completion; `ك ر م B001` nobility/generosity/honoring; `ن ع م B001` bestowed favor. Structural cue: the same verb `ابتلى` appears in both plenty and restriction, and the later `كَلَّا` rejects the human inference. Assigned role: favor and ease are test-materials that reveal the human’s interpretive reflex. Abductive move: I infer that honor bestowed by the Lord is not equivalent to proven nobility, because the following correction separates received honor from practiced honor. Reading change: the ayah reads as a diagnosis of misreading prosperity.

2. **Speech converts gift into doctrine.** Lexical evidence: `ق و ل B001` uttered speech; `ق و ل B012` unspoken inner saying; `ق و ل B013` belief or held doctrine; `ك ر م B008` gift offered for recompense. Structural cue: divine acts (`أكرمه`, `نعمه`) are followed by the human’s `فيقول`. Assigned role: the human speech turns a test-gift into a claim about personal worth. Abductive move: I infer an inward doctrine behind the utterance because later conduct toward orphan and poor exposes the belief’s social consequence. Reading change: “my Lord honored me” reads as an interpretive seizure of the gift, not merely gratitude.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:17 radically corrected this ayah: the repeated `ك ر م` shows that honor is validated by honoring the orphan, so the human’s statement is exposed as incomplete or false.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Honor and ease as instruments of disclosure.** **Evidence/cue:** `ب ل و B002` is testing that makes a state appear; `ك ر م B001` supplies honor and generosity, and `ن ع م B001/B002` supplies bounty and ease. In 89:17-20, the recipient fails to honor the orphan, urge feeding, preserve inherited shares, or loosen attachment to wealth. **Mechanism:** honor and ease serve as test-material, and the later distribution choices reveal the person's hidden state. The packet supplies gift then conduct; I infer that conduct, not receipt, is the test's readout. **Reading change:** the bestowed condition is not a favorable verdict but the means by which a contrary moral condition becomes visible.

2. **A valuable gift mistaken for proof of personal value.** **Evidence/cue:** `ك ر م B008` is a gift offered with an expected return, while `ك ر م B010` marks a dear or highly valued recipient or thing. The person converts “he gave me a *karam*” into “he certified me as *karim*,” even though 89:17 demands that honor be transferred to the orphan. **Mechanism:** the gift's role is to elicit a corresponding generous act; the person instead treats it as status evidence. The expectation of onward response is inferred from branch and sequence. **Reading change:** *akramani* is exposed as a category error between receiving a test-gift and possessing settled worth.

3. **The utterance as a working doctrine contradicted by action.** **Evidence/cue:** `ق و ل B001` is uttered speech and `ق و ل B013` a held belief or doctrine; 89:16 repeats the same speech-frame with the opposite material condition, and 89:17 begins the correction. **Mechanism:** the paired sayings disclose a rule the person uses to interpret providence: expansion equals honor, constriction equals contempt. The packet supplies the two applications and correction; I infer the general doctrine between them. **Reading change:** *fayaqulu* is not incidental self-talk but the voiced theory that the next ayat dismantle.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:16 revealed that the speech was one half of a general doctrine, not a spontaneous expression. 89:17-20 supplied the stronger correction: later conduct made bounty function as `ب ل و B002`, a disclosure device, and relocated `ك ر م B001` from the recipient's status to the recipient's treatment of others.

baseline.text: İnsana gelince, Rabbi onu sınayıp ona değer verdiğinde ve nimet sunduğunda, “Rabbim bana değer verdi” der.

findings.text: Değer ve nimet, kişinin üstünlüğüne verilmiş bir hüküm değil, sonraki paylaşım tercihleriyle iç durumunu açığa çıkaran sınama araçlarıdır.
Kişi, karşılık doğurması gereken değerli bir armağanı kendi değerinin kanıtı sayarak armağan ile yerleşik kişisel değer arasında yanlış bir eşitlik kurar.
Söylediği söz, bolluğu değerle eşitleyen ve darlığı aşağılanma sayan kalıcı bir dünya görüşünün ilk yarısını açığa vurur.

pericope.label: The wealth test, judgment, and tranquil soul

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısındaki insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ve tek bir üyesini birlikte gösterir. Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. Evde kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp ise dal çekirdeğine genellenemez ve yalnızca kendi sözcüksel biriminde korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimlerdeki insan ve insan topluluğu anlamı dal çekirdeğidir; evde hiç kimse bulunmadığını anlatan kalıp ayrı tutulur ve çekirdeğe yeni bir genel anlam katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında yer alan insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ya da tek bir üyesini belirtir. İnsanların görünür oluşu, bu adlandırma için aktarılan bir gerekçedir.

facets.statement: İnsan türünü, insanların oluşturduğu topluluğu veya bu türün tek bir üyesini görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında adlandırır.
Adlandırmanın insanların duyularla görünür oluşuna bağlanması, anlamın özü değil kökene ilişkin bir açıklamadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, dalın insan türünü hem topluluk hem tek kişi olarak gösterebildiğinde ve görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfıyla karşıtlık kurduğunda birleşir. Görünürlük, ortak anlamdan çok adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak sunulur.

concept_gloss.text: insan türü ve bu türden bir kişi
concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanları bir tür veya topluluk olarak anlatırken de bu türün tek bir üyesini belirtirken de kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan türü ile onun tekil üyesi arasındaki kapsamı ve temel sınıf karşıtlığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Türün üyeleri topluca veya görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşıtı olarak anıldığında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan türünün toplu olarak adlandırılmasını açık ve doğal biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam türün tek bir üyesini veya herhangi bir kimseyi gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan topluluğundan tek bir üyenin belirtilmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, insanları görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında bir tür olarak kurar ve görünürlüğe dayalı bir adlandırma açıklaması taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, insanı görünür ten ve yaratılmış beden yönüyle adlandırır; tekil, çoğul, erkek ve kadın kapsamını özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insan türünü iki ayrı yönden adlandırma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanı hem tür hem bu türün üyesi olarak gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yer değiştirme yalnız insanı genel olarak adlandıran bağlamlarda mümkündür. Odak dalın görünmeyen varlıklarla sınıf karşıtlığı, komşunun ise görünür beden yönü kendi sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız insan türünü ve bu türün tekil ya da toplu üyelerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yeryüzündeki bütün yaratılmışları kapsayabilir ve bazı yorumlarda insanlarla görünmeyen varlıkları birlikte içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insan türü ile bütün yaratılmışlar ayrımı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsanlar iki dalın gönderim alanında da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşunun genel yaratılmışlar kapsamı odak dala taşınamaz; odak dal da yalnız insanları belirttiği için bütün yaratılmışların yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insan türünü ve bu türün üyelerini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını, yakınlık ve rahatlık oluşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insan adı ile yakınlık duygusu ayrımı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da insan, temel gönderim noktası veya deneyim sahibi olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Birinde insanın kim olduğu adlandırılır, diğerinde bir kişi ya da şey karşısındaki duygusal durum anlatılır; sıradan bağlamlarda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı. Yalnız insanı adlandırma sınırını yaratılmışlar kapsamından ve yakınlık duygusundan ayıran, okuyucu için en yararlı üç karşıtlık yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi görmeyi temel alır, fakat belirli kullanımlarda işitmeyi, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etmeyi ve çevreye bakarak birini aramayı da aynı dalda aktarır. Bu yüzden dal genel ve sınırsız bir algı yetisi diye tanımlanamaz; her uzantı kendi bağlamına bağlı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Görüp fark etme çekirdeği ile ses işitme, olgunluk belirtisini ayırt etme ve çevreye bakıp araştırma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplardaki kapsam çıplak biçime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görüp fark etmeyi anlatır. Belirli kullanımlarda bir sesi işitmeye, bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini ya da kaygı veren bir durumu sezmeye ve çevreye bakarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını araştırmaya uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi gözle görerek fark etmeyi veya seçmeyi anlatır.
Belirli bir ses nesnesiyle kullanıldığında o sesi işitmeyi anlatır.
Bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini bilip ayırt etmeyi veya kaygı veren bir durumu duyularla sezmeyi anlatabilir.
Çevreye bakıp dikkatle araştırarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımını taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarılan anlam alanının merkezi görüp fark etmektir. Aynı ifade ailesi belirli nesne ve yapılarda işitme, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etme, kaygı veren şeyi sezme ve bakıp araştırma yönlerinde kullanılır; bunlar sınırsız bir genel algı anlamı oluşturmaz.

concept_gloss.text: görerek fark etme; bağlama göre işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görme çekirdeğiyle birlikte yalnız belirtilen bağlamlarda ortaya çıkan işitme, sezme ve çevreyi araştırma uzantılarını topluca verir.

error_profile.preserves: Görme çekirdeğini ve bağlama bağlı üç algısal uzantıyı ayrı olduklarını belirterek korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesnenin gözle seçildiği veya görüldüğü temel kullanımda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözle görme ve görüleni fark etme işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesne açıkça bir ses olduğunda kullanılan bağlama bağlı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin kulakla algılanması biçimindeki özel kullanımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsedeki olgunluk veya kaygı uyandıran durum gibi bir belirtinin ayırt edildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal belirtiden bir durumun varlığını anlayıp ayırt etmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çevreyi gözleyip birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dikkatle bakma ile birini bulmaya yönelik araştırmayı birlikte korur.

onda olgunluk belirtisi görmek ve bunu anlamak

çevreye bakıp birinin olup olmadığını araştırmak

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişi veya şeye yönelen deneyim fikrini çok genel biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Görme, işitme, belirtiyi sezme ve çevreye bakıp araştırma işlemlerini siler.
error_profile.adds: Zamanla gelişen yakınlık ve yabancılığın kalkması anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Yakınlık ve rahatlık bildiren ayrı dalla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, görmenin yanında belirli yapılarda işitme, belirti sezme ve çevreyi araştırma uzantılarını taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi göz yoluyla görüp seçme alanında örtüşür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal görmeyi merkez alır ve yalnız belirli söz çevrelerinde işitme, sezme ve araştırmaya uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir duyu aracılığıyla algılama, bilme ve varlığını saptama alanını genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: belirli algı kullanımları ile genel duyumsama
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir şeyin duyular aracılığıyla fark edilmesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu daha genel bir duyu alanıdır; odak dalın uzantıları ise kanıtlanan nesne ve yapılara bağlıdır. Bu nedenle genel duyumsama her durumda odak ifadeyle karşılanamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir nesneyi görme, işitme veya belirtilerinden sezme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duymayıp yakınlık hissetmeyi anlatır.

branches.branch_image_ar: إيناس الشيء برؤية أو إحساس أو سماع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آنس الشيء إذا أبصره أو رآه، وآنس الصوت إذا سمعه، وأحس الفزع أو وجد الشيء في نفسه، والاستئناس بمعنى النظر والتبصر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: آنست الشيء إذا رأيته وآنسته إذا سمعته (maqayis)؛ آنسته أبصرته وآنست الصوت سمعته وآنست منه رشدا علمته (sihah)؛ آنس من جانب يعني أبصر نارا والاستئناس النظر وأحس بما رابه (tahdhib)؛ فإن آنستم منهم رشدا أي أبصرتم وآنست نارا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişi veya şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Yakınlık ve sevinç, rahatlık veren kişi ya da şey ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvan kullanımları bu çekirdekten bağımlı biçimde açıklanabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yabancılık duymama çekirdeği ile rahatlık veren kişi veya şey ve insana alışık hayvan gibi özelleşmiş biçimler ayrı katmanlarda tutulur; özel biçimler bütün dalı tanımlamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık, ürkme veya kaçınma duymayıp yakınlık, rahatlık ve sevinç hissetmeyi anlatır. Bu duyguyu veren kişi veya şeye ve insana alışık, saldırgan olmayan hayvana da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkıp yakınlık, rahatlık veya sevinç oluşmasını anlatır.
Kişiye arkadaşlık ederek veya yanında bulunarak yabancılık duygusunu gideren kişi ya da şeyi adlandırır.
İnsana alışık ve saldırgan olmayan hayvanı, özellikle bu nitelikteki köpeği anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, yabancılık ve kaçınmanın karşıtı olan yakınlık ve rahatlıktır. Bu durum birine alışıp onun yanında sevinmeyi, rahatlık veren kişi veya şeyi ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvanı kapsayacak biçimde genişler.

concept_gloss.text: yabancılık duymadan yakınlık ve rahatlık hissetme
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin ürkütücü ve yabancı gelmemesi, tersine yakınlık ve iç rahatlığı vermesi anlatıldığında dalın çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yabancılığın kalkmasıyla oluşan yakınlık ve rahatlık bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya şey karşısındaki yabancılık duygusunun kalktığı temel durumda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alışma sonucunda yabancılığın kalkmasını ve yakınlık oluşmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: yanında rahatlık veren kişi veya şey
contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızlığı veya ürkmeyi gideren bir arkadaş, nesne ya da başka bir dayanak adlandırıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yakınlık ve güven veren kaynağın kişiyle sınırlı olmamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsandan kaçmayan ve ısırıp saldırmayan evcil ya da alışkın hayvan için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın insana alışıklığını ve saldırgan olmama sınırını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişi, yer veya şeye alışmayı, ona bağlanmayı, onunla sürekli bulunmayı ve hayvanın evcilleşmesini daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişi, yer, şey veya hayvana karşı yabancılığın azalmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın belirleyici yönü yabancılık ve ürkmenin karşıtı olan iç rahatlığıdır; komşu dal süreklilik, bağlanma ve alışkanlık yönlerini odaktan daha geniş taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişi dışındaki şeylerin verdiği rahatlığı ve insana alışık hayvanı da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal seçilmiş kişiler arasındaki arı, özel ve karşılıklı dostluk bağını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yabancılığın kalkmasıyla doğan duygusal yakınlığı ve rahatlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan türünü, insan topluluğunu veya bu türden tek bir kişiyi adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsan, iki dalda da temel katılımcı veya gönderim noktasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir duygusal ilişkiyi, komşu dal ise bir varlık sınıfını adlandırır. İnsan olmak yakınlık hissetmeyi gerektirmez ve iki ifade birbirinin yerine geçmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı. Alışıp bağlanma, özel dostluk ve insan türünü adlandırma alanları dal sınırını en açık gösterdiği için yalnız bu üç ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأنس أنس الإنسان بالشيء إذا لم يستوحش منه (maqayis)؛ الإيناس خلاف الإيحاش والإنس خلاف الوحشة والأنيس المؤانس وكل ما يؤنس به (sihah)؛ أنست بفلان أي فرحت به والأنس والاستئناس هو التأنس وكلب أنوس نقيض العقور (tahdhib)؛ الأنس خلاف النفور ولكل ما يؤنس به (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın çekirdeği gözün kara bölümündeki küçük görüntüdür. Parmak ucu aktarımı bağımlı bir varyanttır; gözle ilgili belirli biçimlerden genel görüntü veya genel insan anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında aynı ad parmak ucuna da verilir, ancak bu kullanım göz görüntüsü çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
Ayrı bir aktarımda parmak ucu veya eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım da aynı adla verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük görüntüyü bir insan biçimi olarak tanımlar. Buna ek olarak parmak ucu anlamı da bildirilir, fakat bu ek kullanım gözdeki yansıma çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bakanın göz bebeğinde beliren küçük insan biçimli görüntü adlandırıldığında dalın ortak ve temel anlamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Görüntünün göz bebeğindeki konumunu, küçüklüğünü ve yansıma niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yansımanın insan biçiminde algılanması özellikle belirtilmek istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görüntünün göz bebeğinde bulunmasını ve küçük insan biçiminde görünmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız parmak ucunu aynı adla veren ayrı kaynak kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Göz anlamından bağımsız olan parmak ucu kullanımını doğrudan korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: göz bebeğinde görülen küçük görüntü veya yansıma
parmak ucu; eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız göz bebeğinde beliren küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü ve ayrı bir parmak ucu varyantını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal resim, model, heykel veya başka bir varlığa göre biçimlendirilmiş genel örnekleri kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gören gözün içinde beliren küçük görüntüyü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal görme organı olan gözün kendisini ve onun görme işlevini adlandırır.

branches.branch_image_ar: إنسان العين وصورة الإنسان في السواد
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.
branches.source_phrase_ar: إنسان العين صبيها الذي في السواد (maqayis)؛ إنسان العين المثال الذي يرى في السواد أي سواد العين (sihah)؛ الإنسان أيضا إنسان العين وجمعه أناسي والإنسان الأنملة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin kendisini soran kuruluş, seçilmiş yakını belirten kuruluş ve yakın arkadaş adları ayrı tutulur. Bunların hiçbiri çıplak biçime genel kişi veya akrabalık anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kuruluşunda muhatabın kendisini ve durumunu, başka bir kişiyle kurulan adlandırmada ise onun seçilmiş yakınını, sırdaşını veya sürekli görüştüğü arkadaşını belirtir. İki kullanım aynı kuruluş ailesinde bulunsa da katılımcı ilişkileri ayrıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye kendi durumunu soran belirli kuruluşta muhatabın kendisini gösterir.
Bir kişiye bağlanarak söylendiğinde onun seçilmiş yakınını, özel arkadaşını veya sırdaşını belirtir.
Aynı anlam çevresindeki paralel adlar yakın dostu, içten arkadaşı ve oturup konuşulan kişiyi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, doğrudan hitapta kişinin kendi durumunu soran kullanım ile birinin seçkin yakını ve sırdaşını gösteren kullanımı birlikte verir. Yakın dost ve sürekli görüşülen arkadaş anlamındaki paralel adlar ikinci ilişki alanını genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: belirli sözlerde kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kaynakta gösterilen soru ve kişi bağlantısı kuruluşlarını topluca açıklarken kullanılabilir; genel bir kişi ya da akraba adı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendisi ile onun seçilmiş yakını arasındaki iki ayrı gönderimi ve kuruluş sınırlamasını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Sorunun muhatabın kendi durumuna yönelmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakın dost, içten arkadaş ve birlikte oturup konuşulan kişi için sıralanan paralel adları açıklarken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakınlık, dostluk ve sürekli görüşme ilişkilerini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yakınım, içten dostum ve görüşme arkadaşım

error_profile.preserves: Kuruluşun yüzeyindeki çocuk ve soy ilişkisi çağrışımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendisini veya seçilmiş yakınını gösteren kalıplaşmış gönderimi kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Gerçek bir baba ile erkek çocuk arasındaki soy ilişkisini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sözün amaçlanan kişi ilişkisini gerçek akrabalıkla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin kendisini belirli bir soru kuruluşunda gösterir ve ayrıca seçilmiş yakın anlamını da taşır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بلى الشيء أو الثوب حتى خلق، وما أبلاه السفر من ناقة أو راحلة.
يدخل فيه بلو الإنسان واختباره، وابتلاؤه، والبلاء والبلوى في الخير والشر، والمحنة والمنحة والتكليف من جهة الامتحان.
يدخل فيه أبلاه الله إبلاء حسنا، وأبليته معروفا، وأبلى فلان في كرم أو حرب أي اجتهد وأحسن البلاء.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan sözleşme, güvence ve ona bağlı insanlar alanında kalır; aynı biçimdeki kap veya bulut anlamları dışarıda tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları karşılıklı bağlılık, güvence veya dayanışma içinde birleştiren sözleşme ve verilmiş sözdür. Bu sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler ile söz gibi bağlayıcı sayılan vergi payı da ilişkili kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Karşılıklı söz ve güvence, taraflar arasında bağlayıcı bir ilişki kurar.

Vergi veya onda bir pay, bağlayıcı söz gibi işlediği açıklamasıyla aynı alana genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sözleşme, verilmiş söz, güvence ve ona bağlı kişileri ortak bir bağlayıcılık altında toplar; vergi payını açıklamalı bir uzantı olarak ekler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyin önceki durumuna göre nicelikçe artmasını veya düzeyce yükselmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Yaranın, toprağın ve malın artması ile birinin üzerinde bulunma örnekleri bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel artma ve yükselme çekirdeği ile belirli yapılardaki köpük, şiddet ve birinin üstünde bulunma kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin miktar, hacim, düzey veya konum bakımından önceki durumunun üstüne çıkmasıdır. Bu yükseliş büyüme, kabarma, şiddetlenme ya da başka bir şeyin üzerinde bulunma biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey nicelikçe artar veya düzeyce yükselir.
Toprak ve benzeri şeylerde artış, şişme veya kabarma olarak görünür.
Belirli yapılarda köpüğün yukarı çıkmasını veya bir etkinin olağandan güçlü olmasını anlatır.
Birinin ya da bir şeyin ötekinden daha yukarıda bulunmasına uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtların ortak noktası, artma ile yükselmeyi tek bir yukarı yönlü değişim çekirdeğinde birleştirmeleridir; değişen yalnızca artan şey ve artışın görünüşüdür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Miktar, hacim, düzey ya da konumun önceki durumun üstüne çıktığı genel kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem niceliksel artışı hem de düzey veya konum bakımından yükselmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toprağın suyla şişmesi veya hacmi görülebilir biçimde artan bir şey için kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Başka artış türlerini ve yalnızca konumsal yükselmeyi kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyden daha yüksek bir konuma eriştiği karşılaştırmalı kullanıma uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı, başlangıçtaki miktarın üstünde bir fazlalığın ortaya çıkmasıdır.
